location: Help center – Q&A answer (DNS records for custom domain)
old_en:
After adding your domain, the system shows the required DNS records:
  • A Record — Point your domain to the static IP address shown (e.g., 162.159.140.98)
  • CNAME Record — Point to web-v2.dev.ecommercehub.my
DNS propagation typically takes 15 minutes to 48 hours depending on your registrar.
new_en:
After you add your domain, the system shows the DNS records you need:
  • A Record — Point your domain to the static IP address shown (e.g. 162.159.140.98)
  • CNAME Record — Point to web-v2.dev.ecommercehub.my
DNS changes usually take 15 minutes to 48 hours to take effect, depending on your registrar.
old_ms:
Selepas menambah domain anda, sistem menunjukkan rekod DNS yang diperlukan:
  • A Record — Halakan domain anda ke alamat IP statik yang ditunjukkan (cth., 162.159.140.98)
  • CNAME Record — Halakan ke web-v2.dev.ecommercehub.my
Penyebaran DNS biasanya mengambil masa 15 minit hingga 48 jam bergantung pada pendaftar anda.
new_ms:
Selepas anda menambah domain, sistem akan memaparkan rekod DNS yang perlu anda tetapkan:
  • A Record — Halakan domain anda ke alamat IP statik yang diberikan (contoh: 162.159.140.98)
  • CNAME Record — Halakan domain anda ke web-v2.dev.ecommercehub.my
Perubahan DNS biasanya mengambil masa antara 15 minit hingga 48 jam untuk berkuat kuasa, bergantung kepada penyedia pendaftaran domain anda.

location: Help center – Q&A answer (using the AI blog assistant)
old_en: Click the "AI Assistant" button (purple) at the top right of the blog editor. Enter your topic, choose a tone of voice (Professional, Friendly, or Persuasive), then click "Generate Blog Idea". AI will generate a title, content outline, and SEO meta for you.

location: Help center – Q&A answer (creating a blog post)
old_en: Go to "📝 Blog" in the sidebar → click [+ New Post]. Enter a title, write content using the Rich Text Editor, upload a featured thumbnail, set the category and publish date, then click Publish or Save Draft.
new_en: Go to "📝 Blog" in the sidebar → click [+ New Post]. Enter a title, write your content in the rich text editor, upload a featured thumbnail, set the category and publish date, then click Publish or Save Draft.
old_ms: Pergi ke "📝 Blog" di bar sisi → klik [+ Artikel Baru]. Masukkan tajuk, tulis kandungan menggunakan Editor Teks Kaya, muat naik lakaran kecil utama, tetapkan kategori dan tarikh terbit, kemudian klik Terbit atau Simpan Draf.
new_ms: Pergi ke “📝 Blog” pada menu sisi, kemudian klik “+ Artikel Baharu”. Masukkan tajuk, tulis kandungan dalam editor, muat naik imej utama, pilih kategori dan tetapkan tarikh penerbitan. Kemudian klik “Terbitkan” atau “Simpan Draf”.

location: Help center – Q&A answer (optimizing blog SEO)
old_en: In the blog editor, scroll to the "Search Optimization (SEO)" section on the right sidebar. Fill in the Meta Title (max 60 characters) and Meta Description (max 160 characters). You can also click "Generate via AI" to auto-generate optimized meta tags.
new_en: In the blog editor, scroll to the "Search Optimization (SEO)" section in the right sidebar. Fill in the Meta Title (max 60 characters) and Meta Description (max 160 characters). You can also click "Generate via AI" to create optimized meta tags automatically.
old_ms: Dalam editor blog, tatal ke bahagian "Pengoptimuman Carian (SEO)" di bar sisi kanan. Isi Tajuk Meta (maksimum 60 aksara) dan Penerangan Meta (maksimum 160 aksara). Anda juga boleh klik "Jana melalui AI" untuk menjana tag meta yang dioptimumkan secara automatik.
new_ms: Dalam editor blog, pergi ke bahagian “Pengoptimuman Carian (SEO)” di sebelah kanan. Masukkan Tajuk Meta (maksimum 60 aksara) dan Penerangan Meta (maksimum 160 aksara). Anda juga boleh klik “Jana melalui AI” untuk mencipta kandungan SEO secara automatik.

location: Help center – Q&A answer (building a site with AI)
old_en: Click "Build with AI" on the Dashboard or go to Builder → New. Enter your business name, select your industry, describe your products/services, then click "Continue — AI will create your website". AI will generate a complete website in about 30-60 seconds.
new_en: Click "Build with AI" on the dashboard, or go to Builder → New. Enter your business name, choose your industry, describe your products or services, then click "Continue — AI will create your website". AI builds a complete website in about 30–60 seconds.

Kemudian klik “Teruskan — AI akan membina laman web anda”. AI akan menghasilkan laman web lengkap dalam masa kira-kira 30–60 saat.

location: Help center – Q&A answer (mobile-friendly sites)
old_en: Yes, all AI-generated websites are fully responsive. You can preview both Desktop and Mobile views using the toggle buttons in the Website Preview page. The layout automatically adapts to all screen sizes.
new_en: Yes — every AI-built website is fully responsive. You can preview both Desktop and Mobile views with the toggle buttons on the website preview page. The layout adapts automatically to any screen size.
old_ms: Ya, semua laman web yang dijana AI adalah responsif sepenuhnya. Anda boleh pratonton paparan Desktop dan Mudah Alih menggunakan butang togol di halaman Pratonton Laman Web. Susun atur menyesuaikan secara automatik kepada semua saiz skrin.

location: Help center – Q&A answer (customizing the dashboard)

new_en: Click the Customize button at the top right of the dashboard. A window opens where you can drag and drop to reorder metric cards, and tap the eye icon to show or hide specific metrics.

location: Help center – Q&A answer (dashboard metrics explained)
old_en: The Dashboard displays three key metrics: Traffic / Views (total page visits), Leads / Clicks (link clicks and interactions), and Engagement (non-pageview user activities). Use the period selector to view data for Today, 7 days, or 30 days.
new_en: The dashboard shows three key metrics: Traffic / Views (total page visits), Leads / Clicks (link clicks and interactions), and Engagement (non-pageview user activity). Use the period selector to view data for today, 7 days, or 30 days.

location: Help center – Q&A answer (connecting a custom domain)
old_en: Go to "⚙️ Settings → Domains". Click "+ Add Custom Domain", enter your domain name (e.g., abccompany.com). Then configure DNS records at your domain registrar and click "Verify Connection".
new_en: Go to "⚙️ Settings → Domains". Click "+ Add Custom Domain" and enter your domain name (e.g. abccompany.com). Then set up the DNS records at your domain registrar and click "Verify Connection".
old_ms: Pergi ke "⚙️ Tetapan → Domain". Klik "+ Tambah Domain Tersuai", masukkan nama domain anda (cth., abccompany.com). Kemudian konfigurasi rekod DNS di pendaftar domain anda dan klik "Sahkan Sambungan".

location: Help center – Q&A answer (inviting staff)
